about: TEST FIXTURE (tests/cities/run.mjs), never read by the build of the site: the reviewed sentences that only the two waitlist drafts of tests/cities/fixtures (draft-paris.json, draft-berlin.json = cities/paris.json and cities/berlin.json as they stood before the v1.8 flip of 05/11/2026) print. Since the flip no built page prints a partner or a law sentence, so they left cities/_claims.json (74 -> 48) and live here, merged with it only to render the drafts, so that every waitlist guard of the build (kind partner refused on a desk that sells, the carte professionnelle and the trade permit only as law or partner) keeps its test. Same shape, kinds and lint as cities/_claims.json; sorted by text.
